STELLAR MEMORIES COATING RESEARCH RERUN


Duration: 2026/9/26, 10:00 - 2026/11/4, 23:00 (UTC)


- In this coating research rerun event, you can choose and reopen the coating research for one of the four featured coatings listed below. You can switch between different coating research pools anytime during the event.

Threads of Destiny - Selena: Pianissimo SFX Coating

Love's Dawn - Lucia: Pyroath SFX Coating

Tsubaki - Lucia: Crimson Weave SFX Coating

Night Sonata - Bianca: Crepuscule SFX Coating


Event Rules

- Rewards come in two categories: [Special Rewards] and [Common Rewards]. Each draw has a chance to grant either type.

- Research Probabilities vary from 1% for [Special Reward] to 99% for [Common Reward].

- Every 20 attempts guarantees at least one Special Reward. All special rewards have limited quantities. They will no longer be available once they are drawn.

- Each attempt requires either 175 Black Cards or 5 Rainbow Cards.

- Unlock milestone rewards as you reach the following numbers of researches: Weapon Coating at 50 researches, Portrait at 70, Portrait Frame at 90.

- After the event, the unused [Research Items] will be converted into Basic Construct R&D Tickets at a ratio of 1:175.
